bad_guidance.why: Product detail page selected as the top core record for a habit tracker's Today screen; driven by the wrong 'ecommerce' product tag from inspect.
'Order summary at the top on phones' matched 'summary' + 'top'; there is no checkout in the app.
No dialog is involved; chosen only to cover the 'interaction' concern.
The card lives inside the existing ScrollView/NavigationStack; insets are already handled and the task never touches them.
No KPI/summary record (comp-kpi-tile exists), no hierarchy record (layout-hierarchy-one-thing exists), reuse record impl-reuse-before-new was a candidate and dropped.

misses.what: Project product 'ecommerce' (wrong, from a habit-tracker README) entered the request as KNOWN and selected PDP + checkout as core records and grid-catalog / poster-card / sticky-bar / poster-imagery direction slots.
'weekly summary' not recognised as a KPI/summary component; 'Today screen' produced no screen value.
data.kpi_comparison, layout.focal_hierarchy, brand.token_layers, env.glanceable_status never demanded; only touch.minimum_target was 'required'.
impl-reuse-before-new (process.reuse_first) and card-none / anti-card-everything (layout.no_nested_cards) were candidates and dropped for ~600 tokens of ecommerce components.
Density slot changed (4-pt -> density-medium) with no task reason; validator flagged poster cards on a non-media product but the slot was still emitted (exit 3).
theme evidence wrong (Swift 0xRRGGBB hex not parsed), radius evidence from a single twin value, components UNKNOWN despite Components/*.swift.

regressions.query: Add a weekly summary card to the top of the Today screen. (with p5-swiftui-habits inspect)
regressions.expect: comp-kpi-tile or a summary-card record in core; impl-reuse-before-new and a no-nested-cards record in guardrails; comp-product-detail-page and comp-checkout-one-page absent; required concepts include data.kpi_comparison and layout.focal_hierarchy
product_hints not 'ecommerce' (README first line: habit tracker); a sentence mentioning 'habits'/'Today' down-weights a conflicting project product tag

regressions.query: direction for a non-media, non-ecommerce product with surface-elevated-cards preserved
regressions.expect: cards slot never resolves to card-poster-*; a validation violation causes fallback to the next compatible alternative or an unresolved slot, not an emitted violation

regressions.query: direction with change budget 'moderate' and no density words in the sentence
KPI summary card at the top of the home screen (mobile)
regressions.expect: comp-kpi-tile (search #2) survives into the guidance bundle
